sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Fiduciary Administration of Irrevocable Offshore Spendthrift Trusts

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Civil Code, Commercial Code, and Code monétaire et financier governing trust and AML matters)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France–Japan Economic Partnership Agreement (within EU–Japan EPA framework, 2019)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Article L561-1 et seq. of the Code monétaire et financier (CMF), as amended by Ordonnance n° 2020-115 of 12 February 2020 and Décret n° 2020-118 of 12 February 2020 transposing EU AMLD5/AMLD6; Articles L107-1 to L107-7 CMF regarding beneficial ownership confirmation; Ordonnance n° 2017-1182 of 19 July 2017 and Décret n° 2017-1183 of 19 July 2017 establishing the Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs (UBO register) administered by the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of corporate shareholder's registration certificate and register of directors
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registry of Commerce in shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization for non-Hague states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Passport and proof of residential address for each director, manager, and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport authority and local civil registry or public records office

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized power of attorney in favor of the French incorporation agent
Source of wealth and source of funds declaration signed and certified by counsel
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Independent legal counsel or notary in the client's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter from a regulated credit institution covering the settlor, beneficiaries, and related UBOs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing bank subject to home-state AML supervision
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille, Consular Legalization, or direct KYC verification under receiving bank protocol

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, UBOs, settlors, and beneficiaries against: (i) OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List; (ii) UN Security Council Consolidated List; (iii) EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List and EU regional terrorist list; (iv) French national asset-freezing measures (Arrêtés de gel des avoirs); and (v) domestic PEP databases using a 12-month look-back for high-risk roles. Screening must be completed before appointment, repeated at each transaction, and documented in the AML/CTF compliance file. Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) is compulsory, and any suspicion of money laundering or terrorism financing triggers a mandatory report to TRACFIN under Article L561-15 CMF.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet Unique des Formalités d'Entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) and Infogreffe (www.infogreffe.fr) for pre-registration name availability verification against the Registre National du Commerce et des Sociétés (RNCS).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company name must be expressed in French or, if foreign, entirely transliterated or translated into French characters; the name must not be contrary to public order or morality; the corporate form designator 'SARL' must appear at the end; names using non-Latin scripts require a mandatory Latin-script transliteration for RCS registration and all official filings.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Greffier du Tribunal de Commerce rejects the proposed name (refus d'immatriculation), the applicant may (i) submit a corrected new name request through the Guichet Unique, or (ii) file an appeal within fifteen days of the refusal notice before the President of the Tribunal de Commerce (ordonnance sur requête/référé) pursuant to Article L123-5-2 of the Code de commerce. The appeal must include a legal memorandum demonstrating compliance with French naming rules. Concurrently, a second clearance request may be lodged to protect priority, but no automatic extension of the 30-day reservation period exists; a fresh application after 30 days is required.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Conditionally permitted: a registered office (siège social) must be a physical address in France; a licensed domiciliation company may be used under Article L123-11-3 du Code de commerce, but for a high-risk licensed trust administration activity the regulator expects on-site management, local records, compliance staff, and dedicated office space. A pure virtual office is not advisable and may jeopardize license approval.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High (projected 75–90% risk of an unannounced ACPR or judicial inspection within the first fiscal year due to the High_Risk_Special_License classification under ISIC 6430 and the discretionary asset protection trust profile).

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name availability search and preliminary risk screening against RCS/RNCS records
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Infogreffe / Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and apostille/consular legalization of corporate, director, and UBO document bundle
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing official fee scale and consular fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office domiciliation agreement for first 12 months
Drafting of French SARL articles of association (statuts) and corporate governance documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Corporate attorney admitted to a French Bar

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of legal notice in a legal gazette (JAL)
Guichet Unique filing and RCS registration fee
UBO declaration filing (Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs)
AML/CFT compliance manual, PEP screening system, and policy implementation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Compliance consultant / designated AML compliance officer

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Preparation and pre-filing of application for special trust administration license under the French monetary and financial code
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: ACPR / Ministry of Economy external legal advisor
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Legal fee based on statutory complexity and regulatory risk

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Translation and linguistic certification of foreign-language documents into French
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Certified legal translator listed with a French Court of Appeal

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 (SARL formation and governance)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Commercial Court Registry) within the jurisdiction of the registered office
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statuts (Articles of Association) and the M0 form (or the unified formalities declaration via the Guichet Unique)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital; however, the capital must be fully subscribed and paid up (in cash or in kind) as stated in the Articles. If capital is less than €10,000, it must be fully paid at incorporation; if higher, at least 20% must be paid up, with the remainder within 5 years. Funds must be deposited in a blocked bank account until the company is registered.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscribers hereby adopt the Articles of Association of the SARL, and that the share capital of €1,000 is fully subscribed and paid up as evidenced by the bank certificate. RESOLVED, that the registered office is established at 12 Rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris, France. RESOLVED, that Mr. Jean Dupont is appointed as Manager (Gérant) for an indefinite term, with full powers to act on behalf of the company, including opening bank accounts and executing all incorporation and licensing formalities. RESOLVED, that the Manager is authorized to file all necessary documents with the Registry and to publish the legal notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft and Notarize Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary (if real estate contribution) or private deed; otherwise, not required
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Statuts (Articles) in French, including company name, registered office, share capital, share distribution, manager appointment, and corporate purpose. If any contribution is in kind, a notary must value it and draft the deed. For cash contributions, a simple written deed suffices. Ensure all shareholders sign the document.
required_dossiers: Proof of address of registered office
Bank certificate of capital deposit (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry rejects the Articles for incompleteness, correct the deficiencies and resubmit within 15 days. For notarized deeds, the notary will handle corrections.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit Share Capital in Blocked Bank Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Any French bank or licensed financial institution
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary bank account in the company's name and deposit the subscribed capital. Obtain a certificate of deposit (attestation de blocage) from the bank, which will be released upon registration. The account must be blocked until the company is legally formed.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses the deposit due to AML concerns, provide additional KYC documentation or choose another bank. The certificate must be issued within 24 hours of deposit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publish Legal Notice in a Gazette
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorized legal gazette (e.g., Journal d'Annonces Légales)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Publish a notice of incorporation in a legal gazette (JAL) in the department of the registered office. The notice must include the company name, legal form, capital, registered office, purpose, and manager details. Obtain a copy of the publication (attestation de parution).
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the gazette rejects the notice due to errors, correct and republish. The publication is valid for 6 months.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File Incorporation Dossier with the Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (via Guichet Unique or directly)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the complete dossier to the Commercial Court Registry, including the signed Articles, bank certificate, legal notice, and M0 form. The registry will review and issue a K-bis extract (certificate of registration) upon approval. This can be done online via the Guichet Unique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr).
required_dossiers: Proof of registered office (e.g., lease agreement)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a query (e.g., missing document), respond within 15 days with the requested corrections. If rejected, appeal to the President of the Commercial Court within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain K-bis Extract and Post-Registration Formalities
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After registration, obtain the K-bis extract (official proof of existence). Then complete post-registration steps: register with the social security (URSSAF), obtain a SIRET number, and open a permanent corporate bank account. Also, appoint a statutory auditor if required (not mandatory for small SARLs).
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the K-bis is delayed, contact the registry. For social security registration, use the online portal; if issues, consult the URSSAF hotline.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution (ACPR) – for financial services and trust activities
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Agrément en tant que Prestataire de Services Financiers (Financial Services Provider License) – specifically for fiduciary administration of trusts

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministère de la Transition Écologique (via DREAL for regional oversight)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – office-based activity with no industrial emissions; however, waste management and energy efficiency standards apply
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater or VOC emissions; must comply with general waste disposal regulations (Code de l'environnement) and energy performance requirements for commercial buildings (RT2012/RE2020).

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification (Commission de Sécurité) for the registered office, structural load inspection for any vault or secure storage areas, and workplace health and safety clearance (Code du travail) including ergonomic and emergency exit compliance.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP), official portal: https://www.impots.gouv.fr/
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: French SARL entities register with SIREN/SIRET via guichet-entreprises.fr or Infogreffe. VAT identification (TVA) is issued automatically upon registration if turnover exceeds threshold. Foreign-owned SARLs must file for fiscal residency and obtain equivalent tax IDs if conducting French-source activities.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections available in France. Tax classification is strictly determined by legal form. SARL is subject to entity-level corporate taxation under the Code général des impôts. Fiduciary trust administration activities may invoke specific regimes under Articles 238 quater et seq. CGI but default remains entity-level taxation.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (TVA - Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: €85,000 annual turnover threshold triggering mandatory VAT registration for services and goods
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory Facturation Électronique (FET) for all B2B transactions since 2024 with real-time API transmission to tax authorities, digital security stamping (horodatage), and automated clearance procedures for cross-border supplies.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT rate applies to exports of goods outside the EU upon proof of actual export. Offshore services to non-residents qualify for zero-rating where performance is demonstrably outside France with supporting evidence.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DAU), Bill of Lading or equivalent transport document, Inward Remittance Certificate or proof of payment
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent zero-rating claims attract penalties up to 80% of VAT due, interest charges, and potential criminal prosecution. Retrospective clawback applies if export status is not properly substantiated during tax authority audit.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France) acting as the competent national authority for balance-of-payments reporting and monetary operations, with the Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution (ACPR) supervising banking and payment institutions; the French Treasury (Direction Générale du Trésor) administers financial sanctions and foreign asset control.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France applies the EU treaty framework of free movement of capital. Both capital and current account transactions are fully convertible for residents and non-residents involving euro or foreign currencies, subject to anti-money laundering (AML), know-your-client (KYC), counter-terrorist financing (CTF), and international sanctions screening. Profit remittances from a French SARL are permissible without prior FX approval provided that distributable reserves are evidenced by audited financial statements, corporate tax obligations are settled or provisioned, and the distribution complies with the SARL's legal and statutory filing requirements. Hurdles are administrative and documentary: proving beneficial ownership, sourcing funds, and demonstrating economic substance in the trust management activity. There is no exchange-control license requirement for standard cross-border payments, but the Banque de France may require statistical declarations for incoming and outgoing capital transfers through the Balance of Payments reporting regime.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: France does not impose a statutory surrender or mandatory conversion ratio for export receipts. Exporters and service providers, including fiduciary trustees receiving overseas income, may retain 100% of proceeds in foreign currency or convert as needed. However, all cross-border transfers exceeding EUR 12,500 must be reported to the Banque de France for balance-of-payments statistical purposes, and file declarations for financial sanctions and asset-freezing checks. For trust-related export-like service fees, the provider must maintain supporting contracts and transfer evidence to substantiate the underlying transaction.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Fiduciary Trust Escrow and Operational Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium. France permits Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs) and Payment Institutions authorized under the EU PSD2 to provide IBAN-based accounts for cross-border payments. For a High_Risk_Special_License fiduciary administration company and an irrevocable offshore asset protection trust, most EMIs will decline onboarding due to concentrated counterparty risk, opaque beneficiary structures, and the lack of physical presence in the SARL's address. Specialized trust-focused fintechs may open an account with enhanced AML/KYC and restrictions on cash withdrawals, but they generally cannot provide loans, credit, or complex FX products. Regulatory viability is legally sound under the ACPR regime, yet commercially few EMIs accept this classification; a tier-1 bank with a dedicated fiduciary desk remains the defensible primary clearing gateway.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a French SARL whose commercial scope is fiduciary administration of high-risk trusts, physical appearance of the legal representative and each principal beneficial owner is generally mandated for the initial KYC/KYB interview at a French bank. Remote opening is technically permitted using ACPR-compliant video identification and electronic signatures, but banks retain the right to require in-person attendance where the trust structure involves discretionary beneficiaries in multiple jurisdictions, irrevocable settlement, or asset protection features. At minimum, the bank will require: (i) a physical or notarized meeting with the managing director (gérant), (ii) a board resolution authorizing account opening, and (iii) apostilled and legalized corporate documents. If physical attendance cannot be arranged, obtain a full file via a French notary or a regulated fiduciary intermediary before approaching the bank, as most acceptance decisions are blocked without such evidence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Discretionary beneficial ownership and lack of fixed beneficiaries
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide the full trust instrument, a structured beneficiary mapping with defined class descriptions, the settlor's letter of wishes, and a legal opinion from a French or foreign-qualified attorney confirming that the trustee has full discretionary power and that the SARL exercises effective management and control. Include audited financial statements and any regulatory approval from the trust licensing authority.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Irrevocable offshore trust domiciled in low-tax or opaque jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit tax residence certificates of the SARL and the trust, FATCA/CRS classification codes, economic substance report, and written escalation to the bank's Financial Security officer setting out the commercial rationale for the jurisdiction. Add regulatory license evidence and a list of all professional advisers (lawyers, accountants, regulated custodians).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Origin of funds from asset protection arrangements
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver a sworn source-of-funds declaration supported by bank statements of the settlor covering 36 months, audited financial statements of the underlying commercial entity, sale/purchase agreements for any funded assets, inheritance or gift tax paperwork, and a dedicated legal opinion confirming the trust does not prejudice creditors or violate French fraudulent-conveyance rules.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border flows to and from high-risk third countries
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Maintain a comprehensive transaction flow map, counterparty due-diligence file, commercial contracts, and sanctions screening output. Establish enhanced monitoring via dedicated sub-ledgers, proactive tax transparency, and evidence of WHITE (EU) or OFAC screening of all counterparties before each payment. Contemporaneous board minutes authorizing each outbound disbursement should be retained.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Lack of demonstrated economic substance in the SARL
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide the employment contracts of the SARL's personnel, a physical office lease agreement, minutes of board/management meetings held in France, corporate tax and social security filings, and a time-stamped operational calendar of fiduciary decisions, all of which evidence realistic management in France.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound capital funding for a French SARL acting as trustee should be routed via SWIFT (MT103) or SEPA with a valid EU purpose code. For equity/capital contributions, the standard French balance-of-payments purpose code is 'S301 – Investment in equity including contributions to capital of non-resident enterprises' (or the applicable EU Balance of Payments classification). The remitter must reference the SARL's registration, the trust deed, and the transaction nature. The receiving bank will verify the transaction against the ACPR AML file, perform sanctions screening, and may require an FX conversion in EUR at the spot rate. For funds originating from a discretionary trust, the bank will require a copy of the trust deed, a distribution resolution from the trustee, and an updated list of beneficial owners. All inbound wires must include a clear reference to the SARL's tax identifier and the fiduciary client code to avoid blocking. Where the trust funds pass through multiple intermediary banks, use a single correspondent clearing lane (preferably euro through TARGET2) to expedite compliance.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements for trade settlements and trust distributions should be executed over dedicated clearing rails: (i) SWIFT MT103 for single beneficiary payments, (ii) SEPA Credit Transfer for euro-denominated payments inside the European Economic Area, and (iii) Commercial Letters of Credit (documentary credits, UCP600) for cross-border trade transactions requiring guarantee mechanics. The French SARL should maintain at least two outgoing clearing channels: a direct bank line to a tier-1 eurozone clearing bank and a USD correspondent channel via New York or London. For each outward wire, the bank requires the beneficiary's IBAN or SWIFT/BIC, legal entity identifier, invoice or distribution deed, and a completed foreign exchange instruction. Payments above EUR 10,000 require enhanced documentation and possible pre-approval from the bank's fiduciary risk committee.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright EUR/USD FX forwards with a licensed French credit institution or EU bank
Non-delivery forwards (NDFs) referencing emerging-market currencies where underlying exposure exists and the currency is non-convertible
Cross-currency swaps (EUR/USD, EUR/GBP) executed under an ISDA Master Agreement and cleared through LCH or via bilateral collateral
FX options and barrier options in major convertible currencies, subject to ACPR conduct rules and non-speculative hedge documentation
Currency swaps with spot and forward legs linked to specific trust liabilities or investment portfolio hedging mandates

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual ordinary shareholders' meeting approving annual accounts and allocating profit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders / Société à Responsabilité Limitée general meeting; no external governmental filing unless required for approval of transfer or legal matters
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after the end of the financial year (for a 31 December year-end, by 30 June of the following year)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to hold the meeting exposes the gérant to statutory liability; courts may impose a fine of up to EUR 9,000 and order the holding of the meeting or judicial settlement of accounts; administrative strike-off may follow after two years of inactivity

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Filing of annual accounts, management report, and auditor report with the commercial court registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / Commercial Court Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after approval of annual accounts by the annual general meeting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing incurs a fine of up to EUR 2,000 plus potential EUR 20,000 daily penalty if requested by the court; repeated delays expose the entity to an injunction, administrative strike-off, and loss of limited liability defences

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return and income tax declaration (liassez fiscale including balance sheet and profit and loss account)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) / French Tax Administration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a calendar year-end: by the second business day after 3 May of the following year (electronic filing); for a non-calendar year-end: within three months of the year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers a 10% surcharge on unpaid tax, a penalty of EUR 150 per missing statement for annual returns, and 0.20% monthly late interest; serious failure may result in tax assessment and an additional 40% bad-faith penalty

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation and update of beneficial ownership information (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / Commercial Court Registry and the Financial Intelligence Unit within the Ministry of Economy
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Must be updated within thirty days of a change in ownership or control and re-confirmed at the time of the annual accounts deposit; if no change, the annual filing with the registry serves as the annual confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-disclosure or late confirmation may result in an administrative fine of up to EUR 3,000 for natural persons and EUR 15,000 for legal persons; direct civil and criminal penalties apply, and the company risks suspension of voting rights for defaulting shareholders

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory auditor must be appointed for a SARL when the entity exceeds two of the three following thresholds at the financial year-end: total balance-sheet assets greater than EUR 4,000,000; net turnover excluding tax greater than EUR 8,000,000; average number of employees greater than 50.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général) is compulsory for statutory accounts; IFRS may be applied in consolidated financial statements (Règlement CRC 99-03, ANC regulation 2016-03, EU Regulation 1606/2002).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: French law requires the register of beneficial owners to be kept current at the entity's registered office and filed with the commercial court registry. The beneficial ownership declaration is updated within 30 days of any transfer of shares or change in control; an annual re-confirmation is performed at the date of the annual accounts filing, and incomplete or erroneous registrations are penalized by the registry and the tax administration.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Registre des associés / movements of shares)
Register of Directors / Managers (Registre des délibérations et des décisions de gérance)
Minute Book (Registre des procès-verbaux des assemblées)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: R&D tax credit (up to 100% of eligible expenses), innovation tax credit, and other targeted incentives; no general tax holidays

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: IS1 form - Corporate tax return declaration via official impots.gouv.fr electronic portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 15th day of the fourth month following fiscal year-end (e.g. 15 April for 31 December year-end)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income before deductions and exemptions
Computation of corporate income tax liability

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Administrative fines of €7,500 per day of delay; possible criminal proceedings for intentional non-compliance; surcharges of 0.2% per day of delay up to a maximum of 5% of the tax due

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 12.8% statutory rate on dividends paid to non-residents, reducible under DTAs
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Submit Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by French tax authorities along with application form on impots.gouv.fr; approval typically within 30 days
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 25% statutory, reduced to 0-10% under most DTAs; Interest: 25% statutory, reduced to 0% under many DTAs for related party loans

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: €50 million annual turnover for local file; €750 million group turnover for master file
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: French Economic Substance Regulations apply to activities involving discretionary trust administration; requires relevant economic activities, employees, and premises in France

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Underreporting of profits or using non-arm's length transfer pricing in trust administration services
